sources: ReserveAmerica site list for parkId 515 (18 loops, 297 of 304 campsites and 2 group camps parsed)

values.note: ReserveAmerica, up to 9 months ahead, same day included. Reservations need at least 2 nights until DEC's season opens (May 8 in 2026, when its first campgrounds open): 'When the first campground opens for the season, the reservation minimums at all facilities will become 1 night until closing.' A permit runs at most 14 nights, and from July 1 through Labor Day only 14 cumulative nights are allowed at any campground. Register 2-9 pm on the first night or the site is re-rented. Mooring buoys ($15 a night) are for registered campers and book only by phone, 1-800-456-2267.

values.note: DEC lists 315 sites; ReserveAmerica sells 304 campsites and two group areas (35-60 people). Of those parsed, 23 are listed at 40 ft, 111 at 30 ft, 94 at 20 ft, 69 with no length; the 11 sites on Temple Knoll, Flirtation and Waltonian islands are boat-in.

note: NYSDEC campground on the west shore at the north end of Lake George, 3 mi north of Hague and 6 mi south of Ticonderoga; sand beach with a guarded swimming area, boat launch, pump-out and mooring buoys for registered campers. --Claude
summary: Confirmed $22 + $5 non-resident, 2-night pre-season reservation minimum and phone (DEC 2026 summary), 2027 opening May 14, no electric, showers, dump, max 40 ft. CHANGED: sites 332 -> 315 (DEC; RA sells 304 + 2 group areas, 11 island sites boat-in). NEW: season close 09-05, ReserveAmerica platform, 9-month window and 14-night max (were inherited), buoy booking by phone. Note: dropped site/length/facility/hookup/season/booking restatements, the wrong '3 group areas' (RA: two) and the MINIMUM STAY line (booking.min_stay holds it). Not stated: flush toilets (left derived).
flags: Season note (manual, 2026-10-20) says 'Reservable through Sep 5, 2027 (Labor Day weekend); DEC posts no later date.' DEC's 2026 summary does post a close: 'Rogers Rock ... May 15 ... Sept 7' (Labor Day 2026). Suggest: 'Closes on Labor Day: Sep 7 in 2026 (DEC summary), Sep 5 in 2027 (ReserveAmerica).'

Weak waterfront lead: the campground is 'located on the west shore in the northern part of Lake George' with a sand beach, while the entry is 'not waterfront' (RA tags every site 'Near Water - no', as at every DEC campground).
